question: How does the knowable manifest in the śāmbhava awakening without conceptual determination?
premises: The manifestation occurs even without determinate judgment.
It appears suddenly, reflected in the mirror of the subject.
It overpowers the subject and displays its own majesty.
inference: Therefore in śāmbhava awakening the knowable reveals itself directly, overwhelming the subject without conceptual mediation.
uncertainties: The metaphor of the subject as mirror is compact; the gloss preserves the image rather than paraphrasing it away.
plain_english: Even without any determinate judgment, it suddenly appears reflected in the mirror of the subject, overwhelms the subject, and displays its own majesty.
